We got two templates. The first seems to be nitro to amine (retro template: product is amine, reactant is nitro). The retro_smarts_template shows product side: [C:7]-[#8:6]-[c:5]1... with amine attached. That's the template we need. We need to apply this template to the target molecule. The target molecule is the product from earlier: It appears to be the same as in make_8_lvl2-apply_template-1? That answer gave precursors: a sulfonyl chloride and a t-butyl carbamate? Actually the product SMILES is not given directly, but we can infer: The product is the molecule that resulted from applying some template earlier. The precursors were a protected amine and a sulfonyl chloride. The product likely is the sulfonamide: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1S(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1F . Indeed the SMILES in the search query includes that product plus S(=O)(=O) etc. So we have product SMILES: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1S(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1F". That contains an amine (N) attached to aromatic ring (c2cc(N)cc3...). So applying nitro->amine retro template should replace that amine with nitro group on the aromatic ring, giving a nitro precursor. Possibly also other amine groups? The template seems to target an aniline (aryl amine) attached to aromatic carbon. So we apply template ID 2895. Use apply_template tool.

<thought>Now apply template with ID 2895 to the product SMILES to get precursors.
